Ryan White Part A grant funding provides medications and outpatient medical care to uninsured patients in designated high-need areas. Patients currently enrolled in the Ryan White program are eligible for medication assistance, transportation vouchers, as well as medical, lab, dental and psychosocial services provided by staff supported by program income from 340B revenue. Part A grant funds and limited program income are used to  provide access to prescription drugs purchased at 340B discount cost to stretch scarce resources and remove barriers to medication compliance and improve patient quality of life and outcomes. Ryan White grant programs are audited annually for program integrity both internally and by the funding source.
